none: PAS NLM-4DBEA1: Roman Coin: Radiate of Carausius or Allectus
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy radiate, possibly of Carausius (286-293) or Allectus (293-296) (Reece Period 14); robustly cleaned by the finder. Obverse description: Radiate bust bearded right, probably cuirassed. Obverse inscription: IMP CA[---]. Reverse description: Figure possibly standing left. Diameter: 21.2mm, Weight: 2.22gms, die axis: possibly 6. This coin has been considered for Sam Moorhead's corpus for RIC
